other_failure_modes.description: Imputing missing values in the test set using statistics (like median or mean) calculated from the test set itself, rather than using statistics learned from the training set. This violates the assumption that test data should be treated as unseen.

other_failure_modes.name: Discarding CV Models
other_failure_modes.description: The agent trains models in a cross-validation loop but only uses the model from the final fold to make predictions on the test set, discarding the models trained on earlier folds and losing the benefits of ensembling.

summary: The agent correctly sets up a LightGBM model with 5-fold cross-validation but completely neglects feature engineering. More critically, the solution suffers from data leakage due to pre-split imputation, improperly imputes the test set using its own medians, and carelessly uses only the final fold's model for test predictions.
